t: The Skyhook Method: Future-Proofing with Deterministic Systems
s: The Skyhook Method advocates for future-proofing personal and tech systems by accumulating "chisel-strike wins"—small, irreversible advantages—using deterministic tools like Nix/Guix, Linux, and Git. It parallels ancient predictive strategies (desert kites) to engineer resilience and momentum against chaotic change.
sub: Desert Kites: Ancient deterministic prediction & funneling

Nix/Guix: Deterministic system building for reproducibility
